description.translate: Twelve bronze ingots will let me rebuild the fittings and braces on the old pressure rig. This is preparation for careful steam work, not permission to light an abandoned boiler. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The braces are back. The Ranker's research depended on ordinary work done well: gears, shafts, metalwork and machines kept within their limits. He promised to help repair this workshop, then hurried toward the next experiment. As your own industry grows, remember to finish the work people depend on.
